# units/lib

> Durations and sizes as text: units_dur(ns) and units_size(bytes).

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/lib.pkg)

```
print units_dur(90 sec)          // 1m30s
print units_dur(1500 ms)         // 1.5s
print units_dur(250 us)          // 250us
print units_dur(26 hour)         // 26h0m0s
print units_size(1536 kib)       // 1.5 MiB
print units_size(999)            // 999 B
```

| function | gives |
|---|---|
| `units_dur(ns: int) -> str` | a duration the way Go writes one: `2h3m4.5s`, `1.25s`, `20ms`, `3.5us`, `12ns`, `0s`; negative durations start with `-` |
| `units_size(bytes: int) -> str` | bytes in the largest binary unit that fits, with up to one decimal, truncated: `512 B`, `1.5 KiB`, `3 MiB`, `2.1 GiB`, `1 TiB` |

Fractions are truncated, never rounded up, and trailing zeros dropped.

## Needs

- [std](../std.md)
- [rt/str](../rt/str.md)

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
// units_frac writes whole.frac with up to digits decimals of frac / of,
// without trailing zeros.
fn units_frac(b: ptr StrBuf, whole: int, rest: int, of: int, digits: int)
  sb_int(b, whole)
  if rest == 0
    return
  end
  let d = sb_new()
  let r = rest
  let o = of
  let k = 0
  while k < digits && r != 0
    o = o / 10
    if o == 0
      break
    end
    sb_int(d, r / o)
    r = r % o
    k = k + 1
  end
  let s = str_rtrim(sb_str(d), '0')
  if s != ""
    sb_byte(b, '.')
    sb_add(b, s)
  end
end

fn units_dur(ns: int) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  let n = ns
  if n < 0
    sb_byte(b, '-')
    if n == -9223372036854775807 - 1
      // can't negate: the hours part is enough to be right
      return "-2562047h47m16.854775808s"
    end
    n = 0 - n
  end
  if n == 0
    return "0s"
  end
  if n < 1000
    sb_int(b, n)
    sb_add(b, "ns")
  elif n < 1000000
    units_frac(b, n / 1000, n % 1000, 1000, 3)
    sb_add(b, "us")
  elif n < 1000000000
    units_frac(b, n / 1000000, n % 1000000, 1000000, 6)
    sb_add(b, "ms")
  else
    let s = n / 1000000000
    let frac = n % 1000000000
    let h = s / 3600
    let m = (s % 3600) / 60
    if h > 0
      sb_int(b, h)
      sb_byte(b, 'h')
    end
    if h > 0 || m > 0
      sb_int(b, m)
      sb_byte(b, 'm')
    end
    units_frac(b, s % 60, frac, 1000000000, 9)
    sb_byte(b, 's')
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn units_size(bytes: int) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  let n = bytes
  if n < 0
    sb_byte(b, '-')
    n = 0 - n
  end
  let names = "KMGTPE"
  if n < 1024
    sb_int(b, n)
    sb_add(b, " B")
    return sb_str(b)
  end
  let unit = 1024
  let k = 0
  while k < 5 && n / unit >= 1024
    unit = unit * 1024
    k = k + 1
  end
  units_frac(b, n / unit, (n % unit) * 10 / unit, 10, 1)
  sb_byte(b, ' ')
  sb_byte(b, names[k])
  sb_add(b, "iB")
  return sb_str(b)
end
```
